articles.title: State and federal battle over prediction markets regulation heats up after midterms
articles.summary: The midterms lit a fire under state and federal regulators, who are now duking it out over who gets to control the prediction markets industry. If Washington wins this turf war, we're looking at national standards that could either legalize these markets or strangle them in red tape.

articles.title: How Luana Lopes Lara became the world’s youngest female billionaire
articles.summary: Luana Lopes Lara, a Brazilian entrepreneur in her 20s, hit billionaire status faster than most people hit their first million, apparently through some combination of tech, inheritance, or a genuinely good business idea. If this is real and not inflated valuations, it's the kind of "new money, new rules" precedent that shapes how we think about wealth concentration and what actually counts as a billionaire in markets obsessed with net worth brackets.

articles.title: Kalshi says one state’s lawsuit could threaten its $22 billion business nationwide
articles.summary: Kalshi, a prediction markets platform, faces a lawsuit from one state that could dismantle its entire $22B domestic operation if it spreads. Regulatory wins and losses in individual states now carry existential weight for the entire prediction markets industry, turning localized litigation into a nationwide dominoes game.

articles.title: Kalshi sees institutional trading surge 4,124% to $26.3B in six months
articles.summary: Kalshi, the CFTC-regulated prediction market platform, went from niche retail casino to institutional playground with $26.3B in trading volume over the last six months, up 4,124% from wherever it started. That kind of money flow from serious players signals prediction markets are finally graduating from curiosity to legitimate price-discovery mechanism.

articles.title: Federal judge to decide the fate of Utah's Kalshi crackdown
articles.summary: A federal judge is about to rule on whether Utah can ban Kalshi's election and event prediction markets within the state. If Utah wins, it sets a precedent for other states to do the same and potentially tanks the entire retail prediction market business before it gets off the ground.

articles.title: Administration tries to intervene after Kalshi is threatened with restraining order - ABC News
articles.source: Breaking News, Latest News and Videos
articles.summary: Kalshi, the CFTC-approved prediction market platform, is facing legal threats from someone (likely a regulator or competitor) while the Biden administration reportedly tries to block the restraining order. If a restraining order sticks, it could hobble the fastest-growing prediction market in the US right when political betting is about to explode.

articles.title: Casten, Lieu propose whistleblower program for prediction market insider trading
articles.summary: Two lawmakers want to create a bounty system for snitching on prediction market insiders trading on non-public information. If it passes, you're looking at actual consequences for market manipulation instead of the current regulatory free-for-all.

articles.title: Kalshi races to get ahead of New York order that could shut down exchange
articles.summary: Kalshi, one of the few US-regulated prediction market exchanges, is scrambling to comply with or challenge a New York state order that threatens to shut down its operations. If regulators succeed in booting them out of New York, the entire US prediction market industry loses its most aggressive player and potential mainstream credibility.

articles.title: States Begin Taxing Prediction Markets, but Revenue Is Uncertain
articles.summary: States are slapping taxes on prediction market winnings, turning what used to be a regulatory gray zone into actual revenue streams. That's going to make the economics of trading on these platforms noticeably worse for anyone serious about consistent profits.

articles.title: Inside the Fight Between Native American Tribes and Kalshi
articles.summary: Kalshi, the CFTC-approved prediction market platform, is facing pushback from Native American tribes over how their interests are represented in event contracts and market rules. It's the kind of regulatory friction that could reshape which events actually make it to market and set a precedent for how marginalized groups challenge prediction market designs.

articles.title: How the 2026 Midterms Played Out on Kalshi and Polymarket
articles.summary: The 2026 midterms unfolded across Kalshi and Polymarket with real money on the line, and the prediction markets nailed or completely botched the final outcomes depending on which contracts you held. How these platforms performed against traditional polling matters because if they got it right, we're looking at a legitimacy boost for crypto-native prediction markets that could attract billions in new volume.

articles.title: Coinbase Eyes In-House Prediction Markets in First Half 2027
articles.summary: Coinbase is building its own prediction market platform, targeting a launch in the first half of 2027. That's a legitimacy signal the entire space needed, and the liquidity flowing through one of crypto's biggest on-ramps could actually make these markets useful instead of ghost towns.
